## How long does shipping take?
Standard shipping takes 3–5 business days; express is 1–2 business days.

## Do you ship internationally?
No, we only ship within Argentina.

## How much does shipping cost?
Orders over $50 ship free; otherwise a flat $5.99 fee applies.

## Can I track my order?
Yes, you'll receive a tracking link by email once your order ships.

## How do I find the right size for my child?
Check our size chart — we recommend measuring height and chest rather than going by age, since kids' proportions vary.

## What if the size doesn't fit?
Free exchanges within 30 days — just choose a new size at checkout on your return.

## What's your return policy?
Unworn items with tags can be returned within 30 days for a full refund.

## Can I return sale items?
Sale items are final sale / eligible for store credit only.

## How do I start a return?
Use the "Returns" link in your order confirmation email, or enter your order number on our returns portal.

## Who pays for return shipping?
Returns due to product defects are on us; all other returns are paid by the customer.

## Are your fabrics safe for sensitive skin?
Yes — our fabrics are OEKO-TEX certified and free of harsh dyes and chemicals.

## How should I wash these clothes?
Machine wash cold, tumble dry low. Check the care label for specific items (some prints are wash-cold-only).

## What payment methods do you accept?
Visa, Mastercard, Amex, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Shop Pay.

## Can I change or cancel my order after placing it?
Orders can be changed within 1 hour of placing them — after that, they're already in fulfillment.

## Do you offer gift cards?
Yes, digital gift cards from $25–$200 are available.

## Do I need an account to order?
No, guest checkout is available, but an account lets you track orders and save favorites.

## How do I contact customer service?
Chat with us here, email support@jonas-demo.com, or call 1-800-JONAS-DEMO, Mon–Fri 9am–6pm.
